definitions.explanation: Going from bar to bar drinking, or making a habit of going out to drink. The noun form of {飲|の}み{歩|ある}く.

examples.japanese: ⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{飲|の}み{歩|ある}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧だ。
examples.english: I look forward to bar-hopping on the weekend.

examples.japanese: {昨夜|ゆうべ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{飲|の}み{歩|ある}きで⟦{散財|さんざい}→散財：09233_sanzai⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I spent way too much money bar-hopping last night.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}い{頃|ころ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{毎晩|まいばん}→毎晩：00967_maiban⟧⟦のように→のように：30291_noyouni⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{飲|の}み{歩|ある}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: When I was young, I would go out drinking with friends almost every night.

notes:
The noun form of the compound verb ⟦{飲|の}み{歩|ある}く→飲み歩く：19330_nomiaruku⟧ (⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧ to drink + ⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧ to walk), meaning to go around from bar to bar drinking.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {飲|の}み{歩|ある}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to go bar-hopping
- ⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{飲|の}み{歩|ある}き: a night of bar-hopping

SIMILAR WORDS:
- はしご{酒|ざけ}: bar-hopping — emphasizes visiting several bars in sequence in one night
- ⟦{飲|の}み{会|かい}→飲み会：09371_nomikai⟧: drinking party — a single organized gathering, not moving around
